_meta.title: OSPF/OSPFv3/IS-IS LSDB visualization online for building Network Graph
_meta.description: OSPF/IS-IS visualization online for Arista, Cisco, Fortinet, Juniper, Nokia, Quagga, Bird, MikroTik, Huawei, Paloalto, Ubiquiti, Extreme, Ericsson, FRR, Ruckus
_meta.og_description: Upload OSPF/IS-IS LSDB from Arista, Cisco, Juniper, Nokia, Huawei, FRR and more to build an interactive network graph, find shortest paths, and analyze backup paths offline.
_meta.meta_keywords: topolograph, OSPF, OSPFv3, IS-IS, LSDB, Online, Arista, Cisco, Fortinet, Juniper, Quagga, Bird, Nokia, Mikrotik, Huawei, Paloalto, Ubiquiti, Extreme, Ericsson, FRR, Ruckus

title: Graphs
search_placeholder: Search by description, vendor or graph_time
delete_confirm: Delete {graph} uploaded {time}? This cannot be undone.
empty_text: Upload LSDB output from a router or connect a watcher - the graph appears in this list.
compare_banner: Comparison: {graph} from {time} selected. Click the row of the second graph - the comparison opens on its page.
demo_failed: Unable to open the demo graph
wizard_source_lsdb_text: A file with show-command output from a router. A one-time snapshot of the network.
wizard_vendor_hint: One row per vendor, alphabetical. The protocol is chosen on the next step, next to its commands; with a single protocol the step is skipped.
wizard_commands_hint: Run these commands and save the output into one file
wizard_file_chosen: File selected. Drop another to replace it.
wizard_description_placeholder: for example: dc1-core, before R5 replacement
wizard_hostname_note: Carry hostnames and groups over from the latest graph with the same RIDs
wizard_name_hint: The list shows the graph as "{name}", with the upload time and node count. Equal descriptions differ by time.
wizard_choice_hint: A choice moves to the next step at once
wizard_parsing_text: {vendor} · {protocol}. The graph opens by itself, usually within seconds.
wizard_upload_failed: No graph was built from this file. Check the vendor, the protocol and the commands.
wizard_upload_too_large: The file is larger than 50 MB.
wizard_upload_aborted: The upload was interrupted. The file may still have been saved; check the graphs list.
wizard_done_title: The graph was built with warnings
wizard_done_text: Some of the file could not be read, so the graph may be incomplete:
wizard_source_yaml_text: Describe nodes and links as text. Edit them later with forms or text.
wizard_yaml_hint: Letters, digits, hyphens and underscores; other characters become underscores.
wizard_yaml_failed: The diagram was not created. Check the connection and try again.
wizard_source_watcher_text: A live feed of topology changes from a router. Installed on a host you run.
wizard_source_watcher_limited: BGP topology only (BMP watcher in Topology only mode); monitoring watchers are not available for this account.
wizard_watcher_catalog_failed: Unable to load the watcher catalog
wizard_watcher_sign_in_required: Sign in to add a watcher.
wizard_watcher_localhost: Open Topolograph at an address the watcher host can reach, or set TOPOLOGRAPH_EXTERNAL_URL. A watcher cannot connect to a localhost address.
wizard_invalid_ip: Enter an IP address, such as 10.10.10.1
wizard_invalid_ipv4: Enter an IPv4 address, such as 10.10.10.1
wizard_invalid_ip_interface: Enter an IPv4 address with a mask from /8 to /31, other than the network or broadcast address, such as 169.254.1.2/30
wizard_invalid_asn: Enter an AS number from 1 to 4294967295
wizard_invalid_ospf_area: Enter an area as a number or as an IPv4 address, such as 0.0.0.0
wizard_invalid_isis_area: Enter an IS-IS area, such as 49.0001
wizard_invalid_slug: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes only
wizard_invalid_range: The number is outside the allowed range
wizard_invalid_pattern: The value does not match the expected format
wizard_invalid_unsafe: Quotes and control characters are not allowed
wizard_watcher_name_help: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; starts with a letter or digit.
wizard_watcher_video_ospf_gre: OSPF over GRE. The diagram, the router setup, the command on the host and two events: the R2-R3 cost 10 → 100 and the R2-R3 link down.
wizard_watcher_video_isis_gre: IS-IS over GRE. The diagram, the router setup, the command on the host and two events: the R2-R3 metric 10 → 100 and the R2-R3 link down.
wizard_watcher_video_ospf_macvlan: OSPF over macvlan. The diagram, the router setup, the command on the host and two events: the R2-R3 cost 10 → 100 and the R2-R3 link down.
wizard_watcher_video_isis_macvlan: IS-IS over macvlan. The diagram, the router setup, the command on the host and two events: the R2-R3 metric 10 → 100 and the R2-R3 link down.
wizard_watcher_video_bmp: BMP, topology and events. The diagram, the router setup, the command on the host and two events: a route withdrawn and a BGP peer down.
wizard_watcher_video_bmp_topology: BMP, topology only. The diagram, the router setup, the command on the host and the BGP topology.
wizard_watcher_video_ospf_bgpls: OSPF over BGP-LS, with a lab BGP-LS speaker. The diagram, the speaker setup, the command on the host and two events: the R2-R3 cost 10 → 100 and the R2-R3 link down.
wizard_watcher_video_isis_bgpls: IS-IS over BGP-LS, with a lab BGP-LS speaker. The diagram, the speaker setup, the command on the host and two events: the R2-R3 metric 10 → 100 and the R2-R3 link down.
wizard_watcher_token_warning: The token is shown once and cannot be recovered. Copy it now; the commands below already contain it.
wizard_watcher_rotate_confirm: The current token stops working at once, and a running watcher disconnects until it gets the new one.
wizard_watcher_timeout: No answer from the server. The watcher may already exist: check the Watchers list, or rotate its token there.
wizard_watcher_rotate_unknown: No answer from the server, so the token may already have been replaced and the one shown before no longer works. Rotate it again to get a token you can copy.
wizard_error_expected: Expected the output of a command containing {command}, but the file has none.
wizard_error_todo_text: Run all the commands above, save the output into one file and choose it again.
wizard_type_scope_isis: IS-IS changes by level L1 / L2
wizard_status_awaiting_text: turns to Connected when the watcher starts reporting
wizard_watcher_lab_other_server: One-command install works only with topolograph.com; use docker compose.
wizard_watcher_lab_command_warning: The command holds a one-time code and is shown only once.
wizard_watcher_lab_command_token_warning: The command holds the watcher token and is shown only once.
wizard_watcher_lab_command_unavailable: The install command is unavailable: the watcher catalog did not load, or the server has no verified bundle for this watcher type.
wizard_watcher_lab_req_iproute: iproute2 installed (ip, and tc when the announcement filter is on)
wizard_watcher_lab_req_gre: GRE mode: the host firewall allows GRE packets (IP protocol 47) from the router
wizard_watcher_lab_req_macvlan_segment: The parent interface is in the router's L2 segment (access port or VLAN)
wizard_watcher_lab_req_macvlan_mac: The switch or hypervisor accepts the watcher's extra MAC address (on VMware: promiscuous mode or forged transmits)
wizard_watcher_lab_req_macvlan_p2p: The router interface runs ip ospf network point-to-point
wizard_watcher_lab_req_linux_user: Linux x86_64 host; root is not needed
wizard_watcher_lab_req_bmp_port: The BMP TCP port is open from the routers
wizard_watcher_code_warning: The code is shown once, is valid for 10 minutes and works a single time. Copy it now; the command below already contains it.
wizard_watcher_rotate_code_confirm: The current code stops working at once. A running watcher loses its token too and stops; it starts again only with the command that holds the new code.
wizard_watcher_rotate_code_unknown: No answer from the server, so the code may already have been replaced and the one shown before no longer works. Ask for a new code to get one you can copy.
wizard_watcher_lab_code_expires: The code works once, within 10 minutes (until {time}).
wizard_watcher_trial_lab_only: On topolograph.com, watchers are installed with the one-command lab install only.
wizard_watcher_lab_runs_trial: The watcher then runs while you or your watchers stay active.
wizard_watcher_lab_runs: The watcher then runs on the token saved on the host.
wizard_watcher_lab_restart: To restart it later, run this on the same host; it reuses the token saved there:
wizard_watcher_service_intro: Topolograph does not create the service. To run the watcher under systemd, save this unit as {path}, replacing <install dir> with the folder where the bundle was unpacked. A watcher whose token ended exits normally, so systemd does not restart it.
wizard_watcher_service_user: This unit has User=<user>: replace it with the account that ran the install, because the saved token is in that account's home folder.
wizard_drop_text_multi: or click to choose; several files make several LSDB
wizard_add_hint: Another area, IS-IS level or vendor in the same graph.
wizard_list_intro: One graph from several LSDB: a capture per OSPF area or IS-IS level, or from different vendors of one domain. Each LSDB has its own vendor, protocol and file. Once the files are chosen, all complete LSDB are test-parsed together.
wizard_status_unchecked: The test parse did not run: {reason}. The graph can still be built.
wizard_status_dropped: This LSDB does not build into a graph.
wizard_all_failed: The graph was not built: none of {count} LSDB was parsed.
wizard_all_failed_text: The reason is shown at each LSDB. After the fix the graph is built again.
wizard_incomplete_note: Not complete: {list}. Each LSDB needs a vendor, a protocol and a file.
wizard_dropped_note_one: {list} will not enter the graph; the graph is built from the rest.
wizard_dropped_note_other: {list} will not enter the graph; the graph is built from the rest.
wizard_sum_dropped: not parsed, will not enter the graph
wizard_sum_total: Total {count} LSDB, {size} MB of {limit} MB per upload.
wizard_sum_merge: Routers with the same Router ID from different LSDB become one node, for example an ABR between area 0 and area 1. An LSDB that gives nothing does not enter the graph.
wizard_parsing_many_text: The graph opens by itself, usually within seconds.
